hard_dependencies.reason: The predecessor contract is an explicit local planning input.

rows.title: Canonical skill
rows.requirement: Canonical skill remains the only planning entry point.

rows.title: Manual boundary
rows.requirement: Manual Gemini planning stays outside Pi provider and lifecycle authority.

rows.title: Immutable base
rows.requirement: Exact immutable bases are provisioned by the leased delivery helper.

rows.title: Validator bounds
rows.requirement: Validation is deterministic, bounded, read-only, and stateless.

rows.title: Manifest contract
rows.requirement: The v2 manifest contract remains the structural source of truth.

rows.title: Schema parity
rows.requirement: Runtime and generated schema artifacts remain exactly in parity.

rows.title: V1 readability
rows.requirement: Historical v1 artifacts remain readable without rewriting.

rows.title: Dependencies
rows.requirement: Hard dependencies and predecessor outputs are explicit and bounded.

rows.title: Staleness
rows.requirement: Staleness triggers distinguish relevant drift from descendant campaign drift.

rows.title: Digest parity
rows.requirement: Exact plan bytes and acceptance IDs bind to the sibling manifest.

rows.title: Audit corpus
rows.requirement: The AIDEV-132 through AIDEV-140 corpus remains read-only audit evidence.

rows.title: Negative cases
rows.requirement: Independent negative cases cover malformed, unsafe, and unavailable inputs.

rows.title: Review classes
rows.requirement: Review findings remain bounded to reproducible defects, hardening, or preferences.

rows.title: Bootstrap boundary
rows.requirement: AIDEV-182 remains a historical v1 bootstrap artifact.

rows.title: Rollback
rows.requirement: Rollback preserves manual-only planning and separate authority.

rows.title: Two stages
rows.requirement: The two-stage planning and review protocol remains bounded.

rows.title: Trusted choices
rows.requirement: Trusted policy, model, and role selection remains operator-owned.

rows.title: Platform accuracy
rows.requirement: Validator behavior is accurate across bounded Windows and Linux path cases.

rows.title: Ownership
rows.requirement: Evidence ownership remains explicit for fixtures, acceptance, and documentation.

rows.title: Independent approval
rows.requirement: Independent approval remains required before implementation begins.

rows.title: Slice boundaries
rows.requirement: Slice dependencies remain explicit and do not create a mega-plan.

rows.title: Diagnostics
rows.requirement: Diagnostics remain deterministic, bounded, and privacy-safe.

rows.title: Revalidation
rows.requirement: Portfolio metadata binds just-in-time revalidation inputs.

assumptions: Historical v1 artifacts remain readable and unchanged.
